title: Bright Yellow Pickleball
style: Mid-tempo pop-jazz with a playful, theatrical arrangement. A clean, syncopated electric guitar riff provides the rhythmic core, complemented by a walking upright bass and a drum kit featuring crisp snare hits and light hi-hat work. A bright brass section with trumpets and trombones provides punchy stabs and melodic counterpoints. The lead female vocal is expressive and clear, shifting between a conversational chest voice and a light falsetto. The arrangement features frequent dynamic shifts, including a breakdown with finger snaps and a build-up into a brass-heavy finale. Key of G major, 115 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated clean electric guitar riff, upright bass, light drums]

[Verse 1]
[female vocals]
Hmm, like a bee to a flower
Bright yellow pickled ball
And its comforting power
I just want to stroke it for hours
(Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh)
I love my pickleball

[Chorus]
[brass section enters with punchy stabs]
I love to smack it
I love to whack it
Tell it where to go
Clear the net, not there yet
Take off the pace and spin it with their face
And dip it [brass stabs]
And dip it [brass stabs]
And dip it [brass stabs]
And dip it [brass stabs]

[Verse 2]
[drums and bass continue, guitar rhythm]
Play it in the back pocket
Not of your pants pocket, the kitchen
Put it in the kitchen
How many times have I told you
Pickleball are dangerous in the kitchen
(Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh)
I love my pickleball

[Bridge]
[finger snaps, bass and guitar only]
Chasin' it like a dog
Call me a ball hog
[brass section swells]
I love to smack it
I love to whack it
Tell it where to go

[Outro]
[full band, high energy]
(Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh)
I love my pickleball
Bright yellow, comforting power
Like a bee to a flower
[final brass chord, drum fill]
